## Description
**P1 — Web Files guarded Save & Switch can discard edits typed during its pending save.** This is a narrowly scoped post-closure residual defect after [#3171](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/3171) (accepted dirty Web tree switching) and [#3322](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/3322) (accepted preservation of newer edits and dirty state after a delayed save). Their acceptance proves normal navigation guards and that the editor remains dirty after an older snapshot is saved; it does **not** prove that the **guarded Save & Switch outcome** respects that newer dirty state before unmounting the viewer. Do not reopen or alter either closed record.

## Reproduction
1. In Web Files, open file A containing `A`, edit to `B`, then click file B in the tree; the unsaved-switch dialog appears.
2. Choose **Save** in that dialog. Hold the `fileOps.writeFile(A, "B", ...)` response unresolved.
3. While the save is pending, continue editing the still-mounted A editor to `C` (the toolbar disables Save, but the editor is not made read-only).
4. Resolve the write successfully. Remote A contains `B`, while the latest local draft is `C`.
5. The save hook correctly reports `stillDirty=true`, **but returns `'saved'`**; `useFilesWebSwitchGuard.save()` interprets that result as permission to call `commitPending()`, selects B, and unmounts A's keyed viewer. `C` is lost without another decision.

**Rendered-UI reachability (verified 2026-11-21):** step 3 cannot be performed through real user input while the decision dialog is open — the modal dialog makes the editor and tree inert (Chromium probe: editor click blocked, keystrokes land on `body`, editor text unchanged, tree click blocked). Steps 1–5 remain the source-proven control flow the fix must make safe; the browser Case proves the reachable deferred-save behavior, and the newer-draft retention is proven by the composed real-layout integration test.

**Verification:** the control flow is source-proven, and a Chromium probe (2026-11-21) verified that the literal typing interleaving is **unreachable in the rendered UI**: the unsaved-switch decision is a modal AlertDialog, so while its guarded save is pending the editor behind it is inert (`pointer-events: none`, `aria-hidden`, focus trapped) and keystrokes cannot reach it. The defect is therefore latent at the save/navigation contract boundary, not a demonstrated user-facing data loss. The fix closes the contract gap regardless of modality, and the Success Criteria below name the reachable proof lanes (owner-approved revision 2026-11-21; see conversation history).

## Root Cause
- [useFileViewer.ts](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/capabilities/files/hooks/useFileViewer.ts): `useFileSave.save` computes `stillDirty = latestContentRef.current !== submittedContent`, sets dirty correctly, **then unconditionally returns `'saved'`** after a successful write.
- [useFilesWebSwitchGuard.ts](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/experiences/web/useFilesWebSwitchGuard.ts): `save()` calls `commitPending()` on every `outcome === 'saved'`, without checking whether the mounted editor still has newer unsaved content. Its `onSavingChange` dirty check is explicitly bypassed while `guardSaveRef.current` is true.
- [FilesWebLayout.tsx](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/experiences/web/FilesWebLayout.tsx): viewer is keyed by source and path; switching A → B unmounts A and its draft.
- [FileViewer.tsx](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/capabilities/files/components/FileViewer.tsx): Save button is disabled during saving, but editable content remains interactive.
- [useFilesWebSwitchGuard.ts](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/experiences/web/useFilesWebSwitchGuard.ts): the guarded-save bypass (`guardSaveRef`) was cleared in `save()`'s `finally`, which runs before the viewer's `saving=false` effect report; the late report could then re-decide the settled guarded save and stamp a misleading "did not complete" message over a persisted save. Verified by the composed integration test (real layout + viewer + guard + dialog).

## Impact
A normal remote latency window during **Save & Switch** can silently discard a newer user draft even though the editor's own dirty reconciliation is correct. This breaks Session/Workspace work continuity and contradicts the previously accepted navigation-protection intent.

## Fix Direction
Treat a successful write of an older snapshot as **persisted but not safe to navigate** when newer edits remain. `FileSaveOutcome` gains `saved-dirty`: the save hook returns it when the editor's latest content differs from the committed snapshot, and `useFilesWebSwitchGuard` commits the pending switch on `saved` alone — `saved-dirty` keeps A and the one open decision, so only a later save of the current draft or an explicit discard opens B. The guard consumes the viewer's completion report for its own guarded save instead of re-deciding it, so a late report can neither discard the newer draft nor mislabel the settled save. The workspace fixture gains deterministic held-write controls (`holdNextWrite`/`releaseHeldWrite`/`failHeldWrite`) mirroring the existing held-read controls. Keep revision CAS, conflict/reload flow, and existing navigation UX. **Non-goals:** autosave, server-side drafts, global document store, new dialogs, changed dialog modality, or generalized file transaction architecture.

## Location
`web/src/capabilities/files/hooks/useFileViewer.ts`; `web/src/app/experiences/web/useFilesWebSwitchGuard.ts`; `web/src/app/experiences/web/FilesWebLayout.tsx` (composition, unchanged); `web/src/app/fixture/fixtureFileOps.ts` (held-write controls); `web/src/app/experiences/web/__tests__/integration/FilesWebSwitchGuard.test.tsx` (composed proof); Files browser regression fixture `e2e/tests/browser/files-context-create.spec.ts`.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01: In rendered Web Files, a guarded Save & Switch A→B whose successful write is deterministically deferred keeps the one unsaved-switch decision open while the write is pending: A remains selected with its exact draft, the dialog's Cancel/Discard/Save stay disabled during the guarded save, Escape/overlay dismissal cannot close the decision, and tree clicks cannot replace the pending target or unmount A. When the write resolves with no newer edits, the switch proceeds to B and persisted A contains exactly the submitted snapshot `B`.
- [x] SC-02: A guarded save that persists an older snapshot `B` while the editor holds newer content `C` reports `saved-dirty`, and the composed Web layout keeps A selected with `C` visible, editable and dirty, the one decision open, no failure message, and persisted A containing only `B`; from that kept decision a subsequent successful save of the current draft proceeds to B, explicit Discard proceeds to B without persisting the discarded draft, a failed or conflicting save retains A and the draft (conflict hands off to the viewer's conflict dialog), and rapid alternate target clicks cannot replace or bypass the open decision.

**SC → scenario:** SC-01 → **SCN-02 (Chromium + Playwright Web interaction)**: extend the source-aligned `files-context-create` browser Case with the deterministic held-write fixture (`holdNextWrite`/`releaseHeldWrite`/`failHeldWrite`), real tree/dialog clicks and keyboard input, asserting editor text, dirty marker, selected path, dialog state and separately the persisted fixture bytes; executed at exact PR-head SHA with the authenticated E2E receipt. SC-02 → **SCN-02** for its reachable decision clauses (same browser Case), plus the source-aligned **composed integration proof** (`FilesWebSwitchGuard.test.tsx`: real `FilesWebLayout` + `FileViewer` + guard + dialog with the fixture FileOps) for the `saved-dirty` retention clause, whose typing interleaving is unreachable in rendered Chromium because the modal decision dialog makes the editor inert (verified finding above). Both criteria use `method: agent` at PR head per the new-Issue contract; the Agent cites the exact-head source, the composed/unit/integration tests and the authenticated `files-context-create` E2E receipt. No privileged credentials or remote deployment required.
